    private static long process(long[] units, long remaining, int depth) {

import java.io.*;

public class OneBasedArithmetic {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        long input = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        long[] sequence = new long[17];
        for (int pos = 1; pos < 17; pos++) {
            sequence[pos] = sequence[pos-1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long output = evaluate(sequence, input, 16);
        System.out.println(output);
    }

    private static long evaluate(long[] seq, long val, int lvl) {
        long unit = seq[lvl];
        long factor = val / unit;
        long rem = val % unit;
        long steps = factor * lvl;
        if (rem == 0) {
            return steps;
        }
        long alt1 = steps + evaluate(seq, rem, lvl - 1);
        long alt2 = steps + lvl + evaluate(seq, unit - rem, lvl - 1);
        return Math.min(alt1, alt2);
    }

    private static class FastReader {
        private final BufferedReader input;
        private String[] buffer;
        private int pos;

        public FastReader() {
            input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            buffer = new String[0];
            pos = 0;
        }

        private String pull() throws IOException {
            if (pos >= buffer.length) {

            }
            return buffer[pos++];
        }

        public String next() {
